detailedDescription: We deliver institutional-grade direct tax advisory that minimizes risk and optimizes tax obligations within statutory frameworks. From corporate restructuring to high-net-worth individual portfolios, our team anchors your direct tax strategy with deep legal precedents.

faqs.question: How does ABS Consultancy support clients during faceless scrutiny assessments?
faqs.answer: We prepare meticulous written submissions backed by judicial citations, statutory books of accounts, and financial proofs submitted directly on the e-filing portal to protect client interests.

faqs.question: When is advance tax applicable?
faqs.answer: Advance tax is applicable if your total estimated tax liability in a financial year, after deducting TDS/TCS, is ₹10,000 or more.

shortDescription: End-to-end Goods and Services Tax compliance, monthly filings, reconciliation, departmental representation, and refund processing.
detailedDescription: Our GST practice provides complete operational and advisory support to navigate the intricacies of Goods and Services Tax. We ensure your business achieves 100% statutory adherence while maximizing permissible Input Tax Credits through our robust vendor reconciliation framework.

faqs.question: What is the consequence of mismatched ITC between GSTR-2B and purchase register?
faqs.answer: Under Section 16(2)(aa) of the CGST Act, taxpayers cannot claim ITC unless reflected in GSTR-2B. We run monthly 3-way reconciliations to alert non-compliant vendors and safeguard against departmental penalties.

faqs.question: Can you assist with GST refunds on export of goods or services?
faqs.answer: Yes. We manage Letter of Undertaking (LUT) filings and handle refund applications for inverted tax structures and unutilized ITC on zero-rated export supplies.

faqs.question: Who requires a tax audit under Section 44AB?
faqs.answer: Businesses having total sales or turnover exceeding ₹1 Crore (or ₹10 Crore if cash transactions are within 5%) and professionals with gross receipts over ₹50 Lakhs.

faqs.question: What happens if annual ROC returns are delayed?
faqs.answer: Delays attract cumulative daily penalties of ₹100 per form and risk strike-off notices from ROC, alongside potential disqualification of directors under Section 164(2).

faqs.question: What is Form 10BD?
faqs.answer: Form 10BD is an annual statement of donations that must be filed by exempt entities to enable donors to claim Section 80G deduction on their tax returns.

faqs.question: What is the procedure for filing an appeal before CIT(Appeals)?
faqs.answer: Appeals against assessment orders are filed electronically in Form 35 within 30 days of service of notice of demand, backed by statement of facts and legal grounds.
